defs.def: a short piece of music with words that you sing 歌；歌曲

ex.s: Maya Angelou explained she first heard the "rainbow in the clouds" metaphor in a 19th-century African-American song.
ex.t: 玛雅·安杰洛(英语:Maya Angelou)在19世纪的非裔美国人歌曲中首次听到"云中彩虹"的比喻.

ex.s: Going to Mount Huangshan reminds me of the popular Beatles' song "The Long and Winding Road". ___56___ is so breathtaking about the experience is the out-of-this-world scenes.
ex.t: 去黄山让我想起了甲壳虫乐队的流行歌曲《漫长而曲折的路》。___ 56 ___是如此令人叹为观止的体验是这个世界之外的场景。

ex.s: As the song goes, this long and winding road "will never disappear", and it will always stick in the visitor's memory.
ex.t: 随着歌曲的展开,这条漫长而风流的道路"永远不会消失",它将永远粘在来访者的记忆中.

ex.s: Maybe you say “go,” or turn on a certain song, or whatever. ____20____.
ex.t: 可能你会说“走”或翻唱一首歌,

defs.def: songs in general; music for singing （统称）歌曲；歌唱；声乐

ex.s: Go on a boat trip to see whales that jump out of the water and hear the song of dolphins that sing.
ex.t: 乘船观赏跳出水面的鲸鱼，聆听海豚歌唱的声音。

ex.s: My dad came to our New Year party, __22__ as Donald Duck, guitar in hand, singing silly songs.
ex.t: 我爸爸来参加我们的新年派对， __ 22 __扮演唐老鸭，手里拿着吉他，唱着愚蠢的歌曲。

ex.s: However, their songs changed the lives of generations to come.
ex.t: 然而,他们的歌曲改变了后代的生活.

ex.s: To celebrate the 2017 festival, over 1,000 Ghanaian junior high school students got up on stage to perform Chinese songs and dances.
ex.t: 为庆祝2017年音乐节,1000多名加纳初中生登台表演中国歌舞.

ex.s: We do this by doing magic tricks, singing songs, telling stories and, of course, telling silly jokes.
ex.t: 我们通过魔术，唱歌，讲故事，当然还有讲愚蠢的笑话来做到这一点。

defs.def: the musical sounds that birds make （鸟的）鸣啭，啼啭

ex.s: Hear the music of voices, the song of a bird, the mighty strains of an orchestra, as if you would be stricken deaf tomorrow.
ex.t: 听到声音的音乐,鸟的歌声, 管弦乐队的强大压力, 仿佛你明天会聋。
